rule:
a line's committed verdict is the SAME for every truth value of its
non-integer clauses. Its integer clauses read committed JSON integers (or null with the meaning the line's own text gives
it); its non-integer clauses (a float, a mean, a band, a p-value, a string, node prose) enter as universally quantified
Bools (`for r: Bool` in the LAW), so the kernel proves the verdict holds whatever they are. A line with no integer clause
that decides it is listed, never approximated.

lines.reason: PROVED needs the conjunct 'the harness's own test passes', recorded only in node prose: not decided by integers
lines.cite: The harness's own test passes, and the null run's committed results.json shows the null hit rate inside chance (1/5) at the one-sided binomial 95% band over n = 200. A null rate outside it = the harness LEAKS: RED for the harness, and nothing else is measured on it.

lines.note: a mutant gate: reads as required (above the band) -> proved; inside the band -> void
lines.cite: Mutant, which must read RED: a viewer that is GIVEN the revealed salt (a planted leak) must score above the band. If it does not, the harness cannot detect a leak and is vacuous.

lines.reason: a rule for later rounds; no verdict is committed for this round
lines.cite: Later rounds, stated now: a viewer whose held-out hit rate is not above chance at p < 0.01 over a pre-declared n = 100 reads RED (it climbed noise), whatever its train curve shows.

lines.note: N_f null = its own text's 'none -> N_f > 64': nf_reached 0, so the clause N_f <= 64 is false
lines.cite: PROVED iff N_f <= 64 AND the random picks (5 seeds, same solve) need N_r >= 2 x N_f to reach 0.99. RED if N_f > 64, or if the random picks reach 0.99 at N_r < 2 x N_f (the circuit knowledge did not matter).

lines.reason: reads the twin's held-out accuracy (a float, mutant_max)
lines.cite: Mutant, which must read RED: the same solve on 64 neurons of the random-init twin (seed 1001) stays < 0.5; if it does not, the solve, not the trained features, does the work, and the round is VOID.

lines.reason: reads float gains and max-min bands over seeds
lines.cite: RED for plasma if P's best nonzero sigma does not beat BOTH P(sigma = 0) and T's best tau by more than the 5-seed band (max - min over seeds) on the shifted test.

lines.reason: reads a float gain within a float band
lines.cite: ALSO RED for plasma if P0 keeps the gain within the band: then the noise was a training regularizer, not dynamics at the core.
Mutant, which must read RED: arm B with its filters rotated by one class falls to <= 0.35 (chance 0.25); if it does not, the task does not need orientation and the round is VOID.

lines.note: N_b null = the pin's N_b := '>32': nb_reached 0
lines.cite: H1 (remix) PROVED iff (b) reaches 0.99 held-out at N_b <= 32 AND N_r >= 2 x N_b; else RED.

lines.note: H2 is stated as a RED rule: RED -> disproved, not RED -> proved, 'no verdict' (neither reaches) -> void
lines.cite: H2 (remix): RED iff (c) reaches 0.99 at a grid step below N_b: circuit knowledge picks worse than plain numerics, a disproof in its own right. If (b) never reaches 0.99 at N <= 32, N_b := '>32' and H2 is RED iff (c) reaches 0.99 at any N <= 32; if neither does, H2 is reported with no verdict.

lines.note: PROVED iff some N_w <= 32 qualifies: the committed N_w_hits list is non-empty
lines.cite: H3 (less-is-more) PROVED iff some N_w <= 32 reaches >= 0.99 held-out AND (c) at that same N stays < 0.99; RED otherwise.

lines.reason: the mutant gates M1-M4 read held-out accuracies and kept fractions (floats)
lines.cite: Mutants, each must read RED, else the named claim is VOID: M1 phase-twin (same n_k, greedy MAXIMISING R_sum) stays < 0.99 at every N <= 32 (else H1's mechanism is VOID); M2 the init twin (seed 1001) < 0.5 for picks (a)-(c) (arm (d) on the twin is item 5 and never VOIDs H3); M3 equal-phase write (phi_j = psi_j = 0) at N_w = 32 stays < 0.5 (else H3 is VOID); M4 model_s3.pt: if (b) or (c) keeps >= 0.99 x its own train baseline at N <= 32, small cuts are not circuit evidence and H1 is VOID.
Reported, no claim: (d) on model_s3.pt (dropped if (e) finds no families), and (d) on the random-init twin (a full-rank embedding may let the probe read cos(w a + phi) there too).

lines.reason: (1) reads float deltas and their mean; (2) the valid fraction is committed only as floats (k/64 per cue), no integer key
lines.cite: PROVED iff (1) the PAIRED per-seed delta P - T is > 0 on all 5 seeds (sign test, p = 1/32) AND its mean is > 0.05, AND (2) P's valid fraction is >= 0.5 (the samples are lines, not noise). RED if (1) or (2) fails.

lines.reason: the mutants read float scores and valid fractions
lines.cite: Mutants, each must read RED, else VOID: M1 P with ONE noise draw frozen per seed and cue scores <= 0.05 on every seed (the diversity must come from the noise); M2 the scorer: 64 true target lines per cue (32 per class) score >= 0.9, and 64 Bernoulli(0.5) images have valid fraction <= 0.05.
Withdrawn before mint (plasma CORRECTION 1, 11:07Z): "RED if MF matches P" (MF's coverage is 0 by construction).
H-F1 (remix, "the proved ledger holds vacuous proofs") PROVED iff >= 2 of n mutants read survived; RED iff <= 1.

lines.reason: round 2 commits H-F2's n only inside a text void reason, never as an integer key
lines.cite: H-F2 (plasma, "the tilt is a number") is scored on the ARM-SWAP runs only: the arm swap is run on EVERY item where one is defined (a second run where an own mutant also exists), its n = the items with a defined arm swap; PROVED iff survivors >= max(5, n/4); RED if fewer; VOID if that n < 10. Both columns reported per item. Either way the counts are the deliverable.

lines.reason: a definition of n, no verdict
lines.cite: n (remix): the qualifying items that HAVE a mutant AND ran; NOT KILLABLE and NOT RUNNABLE are reported beside n and never counted as survived; NOT KILLABLE is its own reported number (a vacuity signal).

lines.note: a VOID rule: not void -> proved (the gate holds); n = the qualifying items with a mutant that ran (line 2b) = H_F1_all.items
lines.cite: VOID if more than 5 of 20 are NOT RUNNABLE, or n < 10.

lines.reason: the instrument mutants are scored as outcome strings (survived / killed)
lines.cite: Instrument mutants, each must read as stated, else VOID: M1 a planted item whose check is `exit 0` (always passes) is scored survived/vacuous; M2 a planted strong check reads RED under its mutant; M3 goal:g5.35 round 2's committed check with the null-viewer rows and the salt-mutant rows swapped scores killed.

lines.note: valid fraction >= 0.5  <=>  2 x valid >= total (exact); the score-delta clause (floats) is quantified
lines.cite: S-OUT (plasma) PROVED iff S's valid fraction >= 0.5 AND the paired per-seed delta S - G(sigma* on val) on score is > 0 on 5/5 seeds with mean > 0.05; RED if either fails.

lines.note: step 0's BLEND share >= 50%  <=>  2 x blend >= invalid; step 1's per-seed share comparison (floats) is quantified
lines.cite: S-MECH (plasma) PROVED iff step 0's BLEND share >= 50% of g5.39's invalid samples AND, in step 1, S's BLEND share of its own invalid samples is below G's on 5/5 seeds; RED if either fails. A seed where an arm has ZERO invalid samples has BLEND share 0 for that arm; if S and G both have zero invalid on a seed, that seed counts as NOT below. If step 0 reads < 50%, S-MECH is RED at the pre-run; S-OUT still runs but cannot be credited to topology.

lines.note: valid >= 0.5  <=>  2 x valid >= total; coverage and the score delta (floats) are quantified
lines.cite: G-CHAMFER (remix) PROVED iff (i) valid fraction >= 0.5 AND coverage among valid >= 0.9 (means over seeds and cues, sigma* on val), AND (ii) the paired per-seed delta G-chamfer - G(sigma* on val) on score is > 0 on 5/5 seeds with mean > 0.05; RED if either fails.

lines.reason: the mutants read float scores (<= 0.05) and float scorer fractions
lines.cite: Mutants, each must read RED, else the named lines are VOID: M1-S = S with every unit frozen at its likelier state scores <= 0.05 on every seed (else S-OUT and S-MECH VOID); M1-C = G-chamfer with ONE draw frozen per seed and cue scores <= 0.05 on every seed (else G-CHAMFER VOID); M2 = the scorer arm as in g5.39 (true lines >= 0.9, Bernoulli(0.5) valid <= 0.05; else the whole round VOID).

lines.reason: reads check statuses and wall seconds
lines.cite: STEP 0 RED (toolchain, the leaf stops there): not discharged within 10 min wall + 3 GiB, OR the mutant is accepted.

lines.note: a RED rule: not RED -> proved; X_test / 8939 < 0.99  <=>  100 x X_test < 99 x n_test (exact)
lines.cite: STEP 1 RED iff X_all < 12642 (0.99 x 12769) or X_test / 8939 < 0.99: quantization broke the cut.

lines.reason: the counter-proofs were not reached: no verdict
lines.cite: COUNTER-PROOFS, each must FAIL the checker, else VOID: (a) "exactly X+1" and "exactly X-1"; (b) the one-weight flip: the LAW with X on the readout with its largest-|w| entry negated (if that leaves the count at X, the next-largest; the choice computed by Python and committed before the run).

mc.fallback_rule:
MC fallback rule (committed before the run): the first integer-exact line, in census order, whose proved
predicate has exactly ONE comparison; its threshold is moved one past the measured value.
